\begin{exercise} \end{exercise}

2-14. Suppose $A$ and $B$ are disjoint closed subsets of a smooth manifold $M$ . Show that there exists $f \in {C}^{\infty }\left( M\right)$ such that $0 \leq f\left( x\right) \leq 1$ for all $x \in M$ , ${f}^{-1}\left( 0\right) = A$ , and ${f}^{-1}\left( 1\right) = B$ . \end{exercise}
